name: page-typography-scale
description: Machine-readable New Zhanle page-level typography scale from the system typography specification.

androidChinese.fontFamily: Source Han Sans or system default

styles.label: DisplayLarge
styles.usage: Reserved for super-large titles when explicitly required by design.

styles.label: TitleLarge
styles.usage: Reserved for important titles when explicitly required by design.

styles.label: TitleSmall
styles.usage: Content section titles, article subheads, module/card titles, and dialog titles unless a component-specific rule overrides it.

styles.label: BodyLarge
styles.usage: Information article body text and subpage navigation title text where page-header rules allow it.

styles.label: BodyMedium
styles.usage: Most body text, secondary text, large-size button text, and stock/security names in table lists.

styles.label: BodySmall
styles.usage: Limited secondary text display; uncommon and requires scene justification.

styles.label: BodyXSmall
styles.usage: Most tertiary or auxiliary text, medium-size button text, and some header/tab auxiliary text.

styles.label: MarkLarge
styles.usage: Stock-detail business text and bottom-bar text; uncommon and requires scene justification.

styles.label: MarkMedium
styles.usage: Small tags, small buttons, table headers, stock codes, or minimum shrink size for extra-long text; avoid in ordinary body text.

styles.label: MarkSmall
styles.usage: Supplemental auxiliary text and count-only tag numbers; avoid except extreme constraints or component-specific rules.

styles.label: MarkXSmall
styles.usage: Extreme cases only, such as mini button text when defined by component tokens; avoid otherwise.

componentMappings.securityTagText: component-specific tag metrics; regular weight unless tag rule says otherwise
